description:
Titanium products are not part of our normal production runs. Please check back for availability.

The Grim Reaper Titanium BMX frame by Eastern Bikes is the cleanest looking and our lightest weight professional frame

Beefed up with thicker titanium tubing than in the past - between .9mm and 1.5mm

E3 Welding Process unifies the frame parts with the strongest welds possible

CNCed Eastern logo in head tube

CNCed and reinforced seat tube for that unique Eastern look

Spy Seat post clamp - clean look & added strength to the rear triangle

CNCed mid BB - extra-wide to do away with unneeded spacers

8mm thick CNCed dropouts with built in chain tensioners

Replaceable Titanium 990 mounts included

Removable brake mounts and hardware

The Grim Reaper Ti frame is constructed of high quality seamless Titanium using the

E3 Welding Process. We have increased the thickness of our Ti tubing varying between .9mm and 1.5mm to create a strong yet lightweight frame. Our builder is one of the top in the industry and it shows in the quality of fit, finish, welds and attention to detail. Even the brake mounts and all hardware are Ti.
